# Mission

Implement a minimal, tested Python utility library `strstat`: a function
`word_frequencies(text: str) -> dict[str, int]` in `strstat/__init__.py` that
returns lowercase word counts split on whitespace, plus unittest coverage in
`tests/test_strstat.py` (basic, case-folding, empty string). `python3 -m unittest
discover -s tests` must pass. Keep it tiny; no dependencies; add README with one
usage example. Record evidence per Foundry rules.
